prompt.name: Marine
prompt.look: A late-19th-century naval landing soldier: a friendly adult man with a trimmed brown beard, wearing a white pith helmet with a small brass spike on top, a short navy-blue jacket worn open over a red knit jersey, a broad red waist sash, a white cross-belt over the chest with a small black cartridge pouch at his right hip, dark navy trousers tucked into black boots, and a short carbine slung across his back. In his right hand he holds a drawn steel cutlass with a curved blade and a brass hand-guard.
prompt.team_area: his jersey and his waist sash
prompt.identity: the same face and beard, white pith helmet with its brass spike, open navy jacket, red jersey and waist sash, white cross-belt, black pouch, navy trousers, black boots, slung carbine and curved cutlass
prompt.weapon_pose: He stands ready with the cutlass held point-up in his right hand at about shoulder height beside his right shoulder, the curved blade rising to just above his helmet; his left hand hangs at his side and the carbine is slung across his back. The cutlass is well above his knees and nowhere near his boots.
prompt.attack: (1) ready, cutlass held up at his shoulder; (2) he draws the cutlass back behind his head, leaning back; (3) he steps forward and lifts the cutlass high overhead; (4) the cut: the cutlass sweeps down and forward to the right, his arm extended toward the right, blade pointing down-right; (5) follow-through, the blade low and to the right, body leaning forward; (6) recover, standing upright with the cutlass back at his shoulder.
prompt.damage_gear: a dented helmet and a torn, scuffed jacket
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a cracked helmet hanging askew and a badly torn jacket with a ripped sleeve, a nicked cutlass blade
prompt.defeat_prop: the cutlass still held loosely in his hand

states.note: walk built in code from the master and from each damage drawing; the legs alternate by construction
